name: Nagai Yuu
source:
Yuu is very laidback and hates getting involved in troublesome things. She never minces her words, causing her to sound harsh. She finds [url=/c98250]Tsubasa[/url] suffocating and dislikes being around her. She also sometimes has conflicts with [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] because their personalities are so different.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
